next.reason: 1985: "must be subscripted by the first index-name associated with identifier-1 along with other subscripts as required"; 2023: "The index-name subscript shall not be followed by a '+' or a '-'. ... condition-names ... shall be subscripted by the first index-name". The rules match in substance, but 2023 adds two refusals: relative indexing on the key's index-name subscript, and condition-names not subscripted by the first index-name.
